1 (Currently Amended): A humeral implant comprising a first humeral surface component removably attached to a second component.

2 (Currently Amended): The humeral implant of claim 1 wherein said first humeral surface component is a humeral surface and said second component is a removably attached stem.

3 (Currently Amended): The implant of claim 2 wherein said humeral surface has a coronal radius of curvature and an axial radius of curvature.

9 (Currently Amended): The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral surface component is spherically or elliptically shaped.

12 (Currently Amended): The implant of claim 3 further comprising a concave undersurface for bony ingrowth material, wherein said concave undersurface accommodates bony ingrowth materials.

20 (Currently Amended): The humeral implant of claim 2 wherein said removably attached stem has a length that is adjustable to extend from a lateral cortex of said humerus to a center of a head of said humerus.

21 (Currently Amended): The implant of claim 2 wherein said humeral surface component connects to said removably attached stem.

22 (Currently Amended): The implant of claim 21 wherein said humeral surface component connects to said removably attached stem by a technique selected from the group consisting of morse taper and a screw, wherein said connection mechanism is capable of allowing disassembly for adjustment. 

29 (Currently Amended): A humerus bone implant comprising a modular implant with a humeral surface component and a stem, wherein said stem is adapted to be anchored in the epiphyseal-metaphyseal portion of said humerus bone.
